title: From Rocq to Metal: A Pipeline for Formally Verified Microcontroller Firmware
abstract: arXiv:2606.02651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Enforcing invariants in safety-critical firmware is increasingly urgent as generated code becomes widespread, but standard extraction targets for proof assistants require runtimes too large for many embedded devices. We present a pipeline for running formally verified Rocq firmware logic on Cortex-M microcontrollers. The pipeline extracts Gallina to Scheme, compiles it with Encore!, a bare-metal Continuation Passing Style (CPS) bytecode virtual machine, and embeds the result in no_std Rust firmware. We structure applications as pure state-transition functions, so the business logic is proved in Rocq while the event/effect boundary, host callbacks, compiler, and VM remain explicit trusted components. On ST33-class targets with a 50 KB RAM lower bound, Encore! executes Rocq-extracted code end-to-end, stays within the target memory budget on our benchmarks, and validates a transaction-signing application on physical Ledger Flex ha

translated_title: 从 Rocq 到裸机：形式化验证微控制器固件的流水线
translated_abstract: 随着生成代码的日益普及，在安全关键型固件中强制执行不变量变得越来越紧迫，但证明助手的标准提取目标所需的运行时环境对于许多嵌入式设备来说过于庞大。我们提出了一条流水线，用于在 Cortex-M 微控制器上运行经过形式化验证的 Rocq 固件逻辑。该流水线将 Gallina 提取为 Scheme，使用 Encore!（一个裸机续体传递风格（CPS）字节码虚拟机）进行编译，并将结果嵌入到 no_std Rust 固件中。我们将应用程序构造为纯状态转换函数，因此业务逻辑在 Rocq 中得到证明，而事件/效果边界、宿主回调、编译器和虚拟机仍保持为显式的可信组件。在具有 50 KB RAM 下限的 ST33 级目标上，Encore! 端到端地执行 Rocq 提取的代码，在我们的基准测试中保持在目标内存预算之内，并在物理 Ledger Flex 硬件上验证了一个交易签名应用程序。
tldr: 提出了一条将 Rocq 形式化验证的固件逻辑部署到 Cortex-M 微控制器的流水线，通过把 Gallina 提取为 Scheme 并在裸机 CPS 字节码虚拟机 Encore! 上运行，在 50 KB RAM 预算内端到端执行验证代码，并在 Ledger Flex 实体硬件上验证了交易签名应用。
en_tdlr: A pipeline that runs formally verified Rocq firmware logic on Cortex-M microcontrollers by extracting Gallina to Scheme and executing it on Encore!, a bare-metal CPS bytecode VM, staying within a 50 KB RAM budget and validated on physical Ledger Flex hardware.
